exodus.39.p1.b1.text: They hammered out thin sheets of gold and cut threads from them to interweave with the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine linen—the work of a skilled craftsman.

exodus.39.p1.b2.text: From the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn they made specially woven garments for ministry in the sanctuary, as well as the holy garments for Aaron, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

exodus.39.p1.b3.text: Then they fastened them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

exodus.39.p2.b4.text: The twelve stones corresponded to the names of the sons of Israel. Each stone was engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.

exodus.39.p2.b5.text: … so that the breastpiece was above the waistband of the ephod and would not swing out from the ephod, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

exodus.39.p2.b6.text: He made the breastpiece with the same workmanship as the ephod …

exodus.39.p3.b7.text: They made the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth, the work of a weaver,

exodus.39.p3.b8.text: alternating the bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe to be worn for ministry, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

exodus.39.p3.b9.text: They also made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and they engraved on it, like an inscription on a seal: HOLY TO THE LORD.

exodus.39.p4.b10.text: So all the work for the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting, was completed. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

exodus.39.p4.b11.text: Then they brought the tabernacle to Moses …

exodus.39.p4.b12.text: The Israelites had done all the work just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

exodus.39.p4.b13.text: And Moses inspected all the work and saw that they had accomplished it just as the LORD had commanded. So Moses blessed them.
